query: I’m evaluating a 57-year-old female. Among female medicine inpatients aged 52–62 (non‑elective), report mean, median (p50), p75, p90 LOS and percentile rank of 7 days by discharge: home, facility, in‑hospital death.
final_sql:
WITH 
  -- ... (rest of the CTEs remain the same)

SELECT 
  discharge_type,
  AVG(los) AS mean_los,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS median_los,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS p75_los,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS p90_los,
  PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY discharge_type ORDER BY los) AS percentile_rank_7days
FROM 
  los_data
WHERE 
  los = 7
GROUP BY 
  discharge_type;
